Check a model's structure

Source: R/check.R
sbml_check.Rd

Checks the structural rules derivation relies on (design section 4.5): ids are unique, references resolve, a symbol is set by at most one rule (or by reactions and not also by a rule), rules and events do not change constants, and assignment rules do not form a cycle. This is not libSBML's full rule set.

Usage

sbml_check(m)

Arguments

m

An sbml_model.

Value

A data frame with one row per finding: rule ("duplicate_id", "unknown_reference", "multiple_definitions", "constant_target" or "assignment_cycle"), the id concerned, and a message. No rows when the model passes. sbml_check() never raises.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
sbml_check(m)
#> [1] rule    id      message
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
